tasks.task: Plan and run the month-end close

items.when: When a month has ended and you need the order of work from cut-off to the approved pack
When the owner closes the books alone and needs a dated task list with owners and blockers
When you want one guided run from close tasks to draft statements and a note on each line
When the close looks done, to find accounts that do not reconcile and odd entries

tasks.task: List the accruals, prepayments and journals to post

items.when: When costs belong to the month but have no bill yet and each accrual needs support
When an adjustment is agreed and needs debits, credits and support ready for review
After posting, to tie each balance from opening to closing against the ledger

tasks.task: Reconcile the bank and the balance sheet accounts

items.when: When you have the bank statement and ledger and need matches and each gap traced to a cause
When payment reports and the ledger disagree and you need duplicates and missing receipts found
When one difference will not clear and must be traced to its source entries on both sides
When a balance sheet line needs its movement shown from opening to closing

tasks.task: Write the monthly management accounts pack

items.when: When the month is closed and an owner, board or lender needs a pack they can read in five minutes
When you need the statements drawn from the books with the big swings flagged
When lines moved against last month and each needs a plain written reason
When the pack is long and the first page must give the answer and the impact in numbers
When profit is up but cash is not, to show the gap before a reader asks
When the pack is a wall of tables and the reader cannot see what changed

tasks.task: Compare actual results with the budget

items.when: When volume differed from plan and the budget must be flexed before costs are judged
When you have actual and budget numbers and need what moved, why, and a note for leaders
When one team overspent and the budget owner needs a reconciled report and options
When the review repeats each month and should carry last month's reasons forward
When a production cost gap must be split into price, volume and efficiency causes

tasks.task: Prepare a financial pack and ratio sheet for a lender

items.when: When a bank or partner asks for current accounts with notes they can follow
When the lender wants ratios and you need them worked out with a simple health read
When the lender asks how the next 90 days of cash look, with risks named
Before the pack goes to the bank, to catch broken formulas and statements that do not tie

tasks.task: Show profit per product and per order after every cost

items.when: When you have sales, cost, fee and returns exports and need true margin by product and channel
Before any margin report, to find products with no cost set
When freight and duty sit in one bill and must be spread to a true cost per unit
When returns eat margin and you need their true cost by reason and product
When you need profit on one order type with every cost, and what moves it most
When a seller has invoices and sales but no monthly P&L to read margin from

tasks.task: Check a planned discount, sale or price covers its costs

items.when: When a sale is planned and you need the deepest discount the margin allows
When the price itself is in doubt, to compare three test prices after every cost
Before judging a discount, to know the true margin of the products in it

tasks.task: Make a keep, fix or cut list for the range

items.when: When three monthly packs are approved and the quarter's profit by product is due a review
When you need each product's margin ranked and the loss-makers named
When margin alone cannot decide, to sort each product by the job it does for buyers
Before cutting a line the owner is attached to, to name the pressures on the call

tasks.task: Work out the true cost of a unit, batch or dish

items.when: When a batch loses weight or units in production and you need cost per good unit
When a kitchen needs cost per portion from real weights and trim loss
When imported goods need freight, duty and fees added to the supplier price
When stock must be valued at first-in first-out or average cost from purchases and counts
When the unit cost is high and nobody has asked which steps and parts are needless

tasks.task: Report what each job or project really earned

items.when: When you have timesheets, job costs, bills and invoices and need profit by job
Before costing labour, to total hours by person and flag every oddity in the timesheets
When a job is still running and you need cost and schedule indexes and a finish cost
When an estimate looks hopeful, to correct it by how jobs like it really ran

tasks.task: Set a labour and overhead rate and rules for quotes

items.when: Before setting a rate, to see which past job types lost money and why
When you need an hourly, day and project rate from pay, costs and billable hours
When a service firm needs a fee floor, billing terms and a cap on any one client

tasks.task: Find which clients and services really pay

items.when: When a service firm is busy all year with little profit and partners want it by client
When you have a month of paid hours and need utilisation, revenue and delivery margin
When hours, revenue and shared costs must tie before partners see the result
When the review repeats each quarter and should show each client's real rate
When time is logged late or loosely and the firm needs entry rules and approval steps

tasks.task: Build a WIP schedule with over and under billing

items.when: When a contractor runs several jobs and needs to see which are billed ahead or behind
When each job needs its cost to date set against budget and a forecast finish cost
When earned revenue, invoices and cash collected must be told apart for the period
When a half-built job may not have enough money left to finish
When a contract's terms decide when revenue counts and you need the timing set out

tasks.task: Decide a one-off choice using relevant costs

items.when: When the choice is take the job, keep the line or make or buy, and the P&L misleads
When the choice needs new spending and you need payback, return and risk
Before you recommend, to name the pressures bending the owner's judgment
When costs are being argued about and nobody has traced which ones truly change

tasks.task: Build the annual budget

items.when: When you have past numbers and plans and need a budget and forecast with gaps noted
When the budget must be split by team and phased across the year
When the budget is drafted, to see where it breaks in a bad year

tasks.task: Build a nonprofit budget with a cautious case

items.when: When a charity needs funding assumptions, programme costs and shared-cost splits for the board
When funding may fall, to build the cautious case and see what must be cut first
Before budgeting, to know how much cash is free and how much is tied to grants

tasks.task: Track grant money and keep restricted funds apart

items.when: When the bank balance mixes grant money and free money and both must be shown
When a funder report is due and spending must be reconciled with evidence
When a new person takes over a fund and needs its rules, records and open items

tasks.task: Write a finance report for a charity board

items.when: When trustees meet next week and need a five-minute report with restricted money kept apart
When the board has no agreed measures and you must pick what staff and trustees each see
When trustees are not finance people and a figure needs a comparison they can picture
Before the report goes out, to check restricted and free balances add up to the bank

tasks.task: Review the controls that stop money going missing

items.when: When one or two people handle all the money tasks or a near miss has happened
When the quarterly review is due and controls are checked alongside profit
When controls exist on paper and you need a test plan, sample sizes and a gap rating
When the gaps are ranked and the fixes need owners, dates and check-ins

tasks.task: Scan transactions and invoices for odd patterns

items.when: When you have a large export and need the odd ones flagged with a reason for each
Before a payment run, to match invoices and list amounts needing a look
When the check repeats and should carry open exceptions forward with evidence
When one invoice looks wrong and every line and total needs recalculating

tasks.task: Write a one-page approval and sign-off policy

items.when: Before writing the policy, to know which gaps it must close
When time and expense claims need entry rules and approval steps
When the policy is approved and staff need it in plain words with what changes for them

tasks.task: Set up a recurring KPI report from the numbers

items.when: When nobody has agreed who reads the report and what they decide from it
When the report is described and needs the numbers pulled into a workbook you can rerun
When two reports show different figures for the same measure

always.when: Before any analysis of an export, to check for blanks, duplicates and stale rows
Before any workbook leaves, to catch formula errors, broken links and totals that do not tie
Before an owner or trustee reads it, to find accounting jargon and put it in plain words

helpers.when: When transactions are not coded or the bank is not reconciled and the close cannot start
When the job needs a driver-based forecast or a scenario model beyond the budget
When the numbers lead to a debt, funding or sale decision the owner must make
When margin work shows prices or discount rules need a full reset
When the fix is in supplier payment runs or chasing customer invoices
When the pack or cost sheet needs a workbook built to be reused each month

gaps: No library item flexes a budget to actual volume before comparing costs; only the kit skill does
No library item costs a job or project from timesheets, bills and invoices, or compares estimate with actual for one job
No library item builds a contractor's WIP schedule with over and under billing, a schedule of values or a progress invoice
No library item tracks retention held on construction jobs or reports job profit fade
No library item analyses write-offs and scope creep for a service firm
No library item works out a labour burden rate or an overhead recovery rate to price with
No library item handles relevant costs for a one-off choice such as a special order, dropping a line or make or buy
No library item reviews money controls for a small team: who can pay, who checks, and changed bank details
No library item writes an approval and sign-off policy with spending limits
No library item builds a prepayment schedule or a general management accounts pack with notes
No library item writes a finance report for charity trustees or handles fund accounting beyond cash
No library item does break-even or cost-volume-profit work for a business that is not an online store
No library item designs or tidies a chart of accounts
No library item reconciles a stock count to the books
